# Koshman Ecom

> Full-cycle marketing agency for B2C and B2B e-commerce businesses. We launch, run and scale online sales: Shopify stores and websites, Etsy, Amazon, eBay and Alibaba, SEO and AI-search optimisation, Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and ChatGPT ads, branding, CRM and email marketing. Offices in Kyiv (Ukraine) and Košice (Slovakia); clients worldwide. Languages: Ukrainian, English, Slovak.

Koshman Ecom helps manufacturers and brands from any country sell internationally. One team owns the whole path from strategy to sales, with clear goals, revenue-focused KPIs and regular reporting. The first consultation is free.

## Services

- Strategy and growth plan: Business analysis, Sales channels, Growth plan, Shopify CRO audit, Online store CRO audit, Etsy audit, Consultation
- Shopify development: Shopify, Improvements, B2B Shopify (wholesale), CRO audit
- Other development: Custom-built website, Frontend, Backend, Databases
- Website development: Horoshop, Wix / Webflow, WordPress, Improvements
- Repeat sales and LTV: CRM, Email marketing
- SEO: SEO audit, SEO growth, AI search
- International marketplaces: Etsy store setup, Etsy store management, eBay store setup, Amazon Handmade, Amazon management, Price aggregators, Alibaba store setup, Alibaba management, B2B directories
- Pinterest: Account management, Automation, Pinterest Ads
- YouTube: YouTube channel, Channel management
- Branding and design: Basic brand book, Brand book, Logo, Rebranding, Trade shows
- Advertising: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, YouTube Ads, GPT Ads, Marketplace ads
- E-commerce consulting: Consulting, Process audit, Conversion rate, Ongoing support, AI consulting

Full catalogue: https://koshmanecom.com/en/services

## Free tools

- [Etsy profit calculator](https://koshmanecom.com/en/etsy-profit-calculator): net profit after Etsy fees, VAT and taxes, margin, break-even price
- [Etsy pricing calculator](https://koshmanecom.com/en/etsy-pricing-calculator): price for a target margin or profit per sale
- [Etsy vs Amazon vs eBay vs Shopify](https://koshmanecom.com/en/etsy-vs-amazon-vs-shopify): fee and profit comparison
- [Image resizer](https://koshmanecom.com/tools/image-resizer): presets for Instagram, Etsy, Pinterest (Ukrainian interface)

## Apps

- [SEOgenie](https://seogenie.app/): AI app for Etsy sellers — listing titles, tags and descriptions, SEO audit, publishing to the shop; 7-day free trial
